key.name: chord-enabled
key.summary: Summon by holding F and Space together

key.name: summon-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that summons the bar (no side effects, unlike the F + Space chord)

key.name: shake-min-stroke
key.summary: Smallest back-and-forth stroke that counts, in pixels

key.name: shake-reversals
key.summary: How many direction changes make a shake gesture (7 is four shakes: out and back four times)

key.name: shake-min-speed
key.summary: Slowest average pointer speed that counts as a shake, in pixels per second

key.name: shake-window-ms
key.summary: All the direction changes must happen within this many milliseconds

key.name: shake-debug
key.summary: Log what the shake detector sees to the journal while the mouse is moving fast
